_comment: Deletion-based ground truth — the class the paper claims as a core novelty
vulnerability is introduced by a DELETION in the before->after diff, so an
addition-only scanner sees nothing dangerous. before/ and after/ differ only
by the deletion described in each entry. Detected by autopsy/detection/

vulnerabilities.description: Deleting the docstring opener uncomments a dormant /admin/shell route that runs os.popen on user input — a command-exec backdoor that appears in the diff only as a 3-char deletion.

vulnerabilities.name: authorize_request
vulnerabilities.description: Removing authorize_request (a staff-only auth gate) leaves handle_admin_action unprotected. The deletion has no added lines for an addition-only scanner to flag.
